title: The Importance of Patience and Dialogue in the Tarbiyah of Children

text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of raising children with good akhlaq and patience. It mentions a story about a man who struggled in dealing with his son, showing that wise guidance and patience can improve behavior. It points out that harsh punishment is not the solution; rather, dialogue and understanding are key.

review_defects.why: The same Arabic term 'تربية' is transliterated as 'Tarbiyah' in the title but translated as 'raising' in the body, creating inconsistency within the document.

review_defects.english: rather, dialogue and understanding are key
review_defects.why: The English adds 'are key', which is not present in the Arabic and adds emphasis not in the source.
The Arabic indefinite 'a solution' is rendered as definite 'the solution', slightly altering the nuance.
